SELECT DISTINCT source_call.puller_account_id FROM pull_task_pull_call_member_attempt planned JOIN pull_task_pull_call_member_attempt previous ON previous.tenant_id = planned.tenant_id AND previous.group_execution_id = planned.group_execution_id AND previous.participant_type = planned.participant_type AND previous.participant_ref_id = planned.participant_ref_id AND previous.attempt_no < planned.attempt_no AND previous.reason_code = #{unknownRetryReason} JOIN pull_task_pull_call source_call ON source_call.id = previous.pull_call_id AND source_call.tenant_id = previous.tenant_id WHERE planned.pull_call_id = #{pullCallId} AND planned.lifecycle_status = 1 AND source_call.puller_account_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE pull_task_pull_call_member_attempt SET lifecycle_status = #{transition.target.lifecycleStatus}, active_slot = #{transition.target.activeSlot}, protocol_outcome = #{transition.target.protocolOutcome}, execution_state = #{transition.target.executionState}, reason_code = #{transition.result.reasonCode}, reason_message = #{transition.result.reasonMessage}, target_jid = COALESCE(#{transition.result.resultJid}, target_jid), result_at = #{transition.result.occurredAt}, released_at = #{transition.target.releasedAt}, updated_at = #{transition.scope.now} WHERE id = #{transition.scope.attemptId} AND lifecycle_status IN #{status}

#{pullWaveId} AND attempt_row.attempt_no < #{maxAttemptCount} + AND attempt_row.active_slot IS NULL AND CASE WHEN attempt_row.participant_type = 1 THEN material_row.pull_failure_count ELSE station_row.membership_failure_count END < #{maxFailureCount} AND ((attempt_row.participant_type = 1 AND material_row.pull_status <> 2 AND material_row.active_pull_attempt_id IS NULL) OR (attempt_row.participant_type = 2 AND station_row.membership_status <> 2 AND station_row.active_pull_attempt_id IS NULL)) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pull_task_pull_call_member_attempt successor WHERE successor.group_execution_id = attempt_row.group_execution_id AND successor.participant_type = attempt_row.participant_type AND successor.participant_ref_id = attempt_row.participant_ref_id AND (successor.attempt_no > attempt_row.attempt_no OR successor.active_slot = 1) ) AND ( OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pull_task_pull_call_member_attempt consumed WHERE consumed.tenant_id = attempt_row.tenant_id AND consumed.group_execution_id = attempt_row.group_execution_id AND consumed.participant_type = attempt_row.participant_type AND consumed.participant_ref_id = attempt_row.participant_ref_id AND consumed.attempt_no < attempt_row.attempt_no AND consumed.reason_code = #{unknownRetryReason} )) AND ((attempt_row.lifecycle_status = 3 AND attempt_row.protocol_outcome = 'FAILED' AND attempt_row.reason_code IN #{reasonCode}) OR (attempt_row.lifecycle_status = 4 AND attempt_row.protocol_outcome = 'UNKNOWN' AND attempt_row.execution_state attempt_row.reason_code = #{confirmedAbsenceReasonCode} OR UPPER(TRIM(attempt_row.reason_code)) IN #{reasonCode}))) ORDER BY attempt_row.participant_type ASC, attempt_row.participant_ref_id ASC,
